comment: C13 chlorination in the welwitindolinone biosynthetic pathway.

reactions.description: Chlorination at the C13 position of indole alkaloid substrates by WelO5.
Chlorination of 12-epi-fischerindole U to produce 12-epi-fischerindole G.
Chlorination of 12-epi-hapalindole C to produce 12-epi-hapalindole E.
